description: This file defines a ViewModel class 'SignUpViewModel' used in an Android app's sign-up UI. It manages validation errors, general errors, and navigation state related to the sign-up process. It interacts with a Validation helper class for input validation.

classes.name: SignUpViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel for managing the sign-up UI logic, including field validation, error handling, and navigation events.

methods.name: onSignUpClicked
methods.description: Validates the email, password, and confirm password fields; updates error messages; and triggers navigation to the dashboard if inputs are valid.

methods.name: onNavigatedToDashboard
methods.description: Resets the navigation LiveData to prevent repeated navigation events.
